verdict.rationale: Cloudflare directly documents CPU-time-based billing rather than wall-clock billing: 'Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets,' and the Agents SDK docs state that hibernating agents 'cost nothing when inactive' even at millions of instances. This matches the devops-lead's pay-for-active-compute pricing model closely. Missing for 10: independent/third-party billing verification or invoice examples, and clearer documentation of how this squares with community-reported per-invocation CPU-time limits (e.g., 30s free/15min paid) for long-running workloads.
